fields.ic_name: ARM CoreSight On-Chip Debug and Trace Architecture

low_power_modes_summary.CSYSPWRUPREQ_ACK_handshake: Host writes CSYSPWRUPREQ=1; reads CTRL/STAT and waits for CSYSPWRUPACK=1.
low_power_modes_summary.CDBGPWRUPREQ_ACK_handshake: Host writes CDBGPWRUPREQ=1; waits for CDBGPWRUPACK=1. Without it, DHCSR access returns FAULT.
low_power_modes_summary.CDBGRSTREQ_ACK_handshake: Host writes CDBGRSTREQ=1; waits for CDBGRSTACK=1.
low_power_modes_summary.SWCLK_stopped_in_idle: SW-DP FSM holds Idle when host stops SWCLK; dynamic current drops to leakage.
low_power_modes_summary.DAP_always_on_partitioning: SW-DP wire-level FSM + DP register set placed in always-on debug-power domain.

swd_in_deep_sleep_use_case: Cortex-M MCUs enter WFI/WFE / standby with CPU clock gated. SW-DP can remain alive in always-on.
Host probe asserts CDBGPWRUPREQ + CSYSPWRUPREQ to wake debug + system power domains.
isolation_clamps_during_power_gate: Isolation clamps required between MEM-AP and gated system bus.
Host accesses return FAULT (STICKYERR) until system domain powered up.
fields.notes: The architectural power feature is the request/acknowledge handshake that brings up (and holds up) the debug and system power domains. Detailed UPF/power-domain structure is an implementation concern; no numeric power values are defined or invented.

power_management_states.name: PowerDown
power_management_states.description: Debug domain not powered; the DP power-up handshake has not (yet) been granted.

power_management_states.name: PowerUp
power_management_states.description: CDBGPWRUPACK/CSYSPWRUPACK granted; debug logic powered and clocked, AP accesses allowed.

fields.wakeup_mechanism: The Debug Port requests power for the debug and system domains via CDBGPWRUPREQ and CSYSPWRUPREQ in CTRL/STAT; the SoC power controller acknowledges with CDBGPWRUPACK and CSYSPWRUPACK. A debugger can hold the debug domain powered so it survives the core's own low-power states.

power_rails.purpose: CoreSight debug/trace logic (can be powered independently of the cores).
The buses/memory the DAP reaches; requested via CSYSPWRUPREQ.

fields.coresight_power_considerations: CoreSight's protocol-level power intent is the DAP power-up handshake (separately power the debug vs system domains) so debug can persist across core power-down. Fine-grained power-domain partitioning, isolation, and retention are SoC implementation concerns.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
